$comment: Changing an HVAC system (City of Kitchener residential building permits page, #hvacsystem). Required documents: the application form with its Schedule 1 (one upload: Schedule 1 is page 3 of the same Ontario PDF, completed by the BCIN HVAC designer) and the heat loss/heat gain calculations. The form's own fields are in general.json, shared by every project type. Fields are checked visually for presence and likely plausibility, with boolean decisions only.

details.label: Individual BCIN
details.section: Schedule 1, Section D: Declaration of designer
details.missingMessage: Add the designer’s individual BCIN. The City asks for Schedule 1 from a BCIN HVAC designer.
details.whereToAdd: Schedule 1, Section D (Declaration of designer): select the applicable statement and fill in its 'Individual BCIN'. First identify the visibly marked registered-firm or 'other designer' statement; if neither or both are marked, first select exactly one applicable statement. The registered-firm statement uses the first BCIN box; the 'other designer' statement uses the second. These are alternatives: the unused box may stay blank. A number only under an unselected statement does not fill the selected statement's box.
